description: Run your Audiobookshelf audiobook and podcast server from workflows: list, search and update books and podcasts, match them, scan libraries, manage collections and playlists, add podcasts and download episodes, track listening progress and stats, and add users. Start a workflow when a book or episode arrives, a book is finished, or someone starts listening.

audiobookshelf_item_finished_trigger.description: Runs when the API key's user finishes a book or an episode, in any app, or marks one finished, such as to log it or start the next in a series. What was finished before the workflow is turned on doesn't run it.

audiobookshelf_listening_session_trigger.description: Runs when the API key's user starts listening to a book or an episode in any Audiobookshelf app, with what they're playing and on which device.

audiobookshelf_new_episode_trigger.description: Runs when a new episode is downloaded into a library, for every show or only the one chosen, such as to add it to a playlist or send a note. Episodes already there when the workflow is turned on, or already finished, don't run it.

parameters.description: Only this podcast library, by name or ID. Leave blank for every podcast library.

audiobookshelf_new_item_trigger.description: Runs when a book or podcast is added to a library, by a scan, an upload or Add podcast, with its details. Items already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.
